scope: Replace the previous terminal-drain-only balcony condition with an actual geometry-based floor fall that carries water from the rear threshold zone to the terminal channel, and bind that construction to formal reflection evidence.

commits.message: feat: model balcony floor drainage fall
commits.purpose: Adds one deterministic purpose-built sloped floor mesh per balcony bay, a migration path from the previous two-renderer assembly, metric-like UV0, hard construction normals and coherent sky/local-probe usage.

commits.message: qa: enforce balcony floor fall geometry
commits.purpose: Formal QA requires 30 floor-fall renderers, exact 0.84 m run / 16.8 mm drop / 2 percent slope, complete UV0/normal/tangent evidence, slab attachment and channel termination.

commits.message: docs: define physical balcony floor fall contract
commits.purpose: Records manufacture/installation, dimensions, interfaces, orientation, dry exposure, cause-based aging, PBR material behavior, shared-all-LOD-state policy and precise lookdev generation brief.

commits.message: qa: bind balcony fall to reflection evidence
commits.purpose: Runs balcony construction QA inside the existing formal reflection-lighting fingerprint lifecycle so the cubemap cannot be sealed against a stale flat/no-fall balcony state.

researchBasis.source: Kaneso balcony/roof drain product families already recorded in the balcony drainage contract

researchBasis.use: 1:50 fall adopted only as a conservative benchmark reconstruction assumption, not as proof of the original building detail.

manufactureAndInstallation.components: Existing rear upstands + threshold turn + new formed walking-field fall + terminal channel + coated drain grate.

floorFall.mounting: formed/bonded over the slab between rear threshold turn and terminal channel
floorFall.orientation: falls in +Z toward the terminal channel
floorFall.geometryVsMaterial: macro fall is geometry; fine membrane orange-peel/chalking is material-scale only

material.angularFresnel: ordinary dielectric Fresnel; no painted edge highlight

sourceVerification.floorFallMath: PASS_SOURCE_MATH: rearZ=-0.46, frontZ=0.38 => run=0.84 m; 0.84/50=0.0168 m drop; front top 0.0015 m => rear top 0.0183 m; slope=0.02.
sourceVerification.meshTopology: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_EXECUTED: six independent quad faces, 24 vertices, 36 indices, UV0 + recalculated normals/tangents; no Unity primitive mesh is used.
sourceVerification.migration: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_EXECUTED: existing 30-bay drainage roots gain only missing FloorFallSurface children; unrelated drift remains fail-closed under QA.
sourceVerification.sceneQA: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_EXECUTED: requires 90 renderers total (30 waterproof assemblies + 30 floor falls + 30 drain grates), exact canonical bindings and floor/channel/slab relationships.
sourceVerification.formalMainCameraQA: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_EXECUTED: existing MainCamera pre-cull guard now rejects missing/drifted floor-fall state.
sourceVerification.formalReflectionQA: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_EXECUTED: existing reflection-lighting fingerprint now invokes balcony drainage/floor-fall QA before request, during poll/completion and before still sealing through the central material-physicality binding.

fixedFindings: The prior balcony contract explicitly withheld visual credit for broad floor fall because no sloped surface existed. This run removes that implementation gap by making the 1:50 fall actual geometry and by QA-binding the exact drop/run rather than relying on a normal-map or painted cue.

ReflectionProbe.RenderProbe bypasses MainCamera pre-cull. Balcony construction QA is therefore chained into the existing reflection-lighting fingerprint so cubemap and still evidence cannot silently use different balcony generations.
knownLimitations: The 1:50 fall is a conservative benchmark reconstruction assumption, not verified original-building documentation.

The lower face uses a 0.5 mm render epsilon above the slab datum to avoid coplanar depth fighting; this is treated as the concealed bonded interface, not a modeled air cavity. A visible hairline gap in real pixels would be a defect and must be corrected.
The waterproof material currently has no normal texture; normalScale remains 0.0 rather than inventing unsupported micro-normal response.

The shared-all-LOD-state assembly is deliberately not switched by DanchiHighDetail LODGroup; temporal evidence must still check grate/edge shimmer and any apparent pop caused by surrounding geometry transitions.
No native Unity compile, scene migration, ReflectionProbe execution or rendered pixels are available at this head.

implementationReadiness.reason: Source/data/QA coverage increased, but the principal blocker remains unavailable Unity 6000.3.0f1 runtime and actual native-4K evidence; readiness is not inflated for source-only additions.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.geometry_and_construction_fidelity: DIRECT_POSITIVE_CANDIDATE: water now has an actual 16.8 mm gravity fall from threshold zone to channel rather than a flat slab with terminal hardware only.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.material_pbr_physical_plausibility: SUPPORTING_CANDIDATE: the sloped waterproof surface uses the same constrained dry dielectric material; no painted fall/highlight is introduced.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.lighting_shadows_reflections: SUPPORTING_CANDIDATE: true slope changes grazing angle and reflected sky response; reflection lifecycle now fails closed on missing/drifted slope state.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.weathering_context_causality: DIRECT_POSITIVE_CANDIDATE: future residue has a physical gravity path to the channel/drain instead of arbitrary floor staining.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.period_accuracy_scene_authenticity: SUPPORTING_CANDIDATE: ordinary drainage construction reads more credibly, but exact historical product/specification is not claimed.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.temporal_lod_aliasing_stability: RISK_ONLY_UNTIL_RENDER: the broad slope itself is stable across LOD states, but millimetric front edge and grate require temporal pixel review.
